reason: I earn about $10,000 a year, and $89 a month is over ten percent of that for a tool I can already replace with Excel and Telegram for free. I would try the free trial, but I would not pay.
objection: AI calls and voice are not working yet, so why would I pay for them? And only 1 to 5 companies pay, with no references, so I would be the guinea pig at a price I can't afford.
would_change_my_mind: A price of about $15 to $20 a month, or a free plan that works for good, plus a few Uzbek shops like mine that I can ask.
